supports: Buying 6.6630, selling 6.6911 RMB per USD. The bank's own 'Middle Rate' column (6.7191) is not the mid-point of buying and selling, so the pages compute their own mid-point and say so.

title: 中国银行电子银行个人服务转账汇款费率表 (personal e-banking transfer tariff)
quote: 跨境汇款（电汇）：每笔汇款金额的1‰，最低收取50元/笔，最高收取260元/笔；另收电讯费,港澳台地区人民币80元/笔,非港澳台地区人民币150元/笔。
supports: Cross-border wire: 1 per mille of the amount, floor RMB 50, ceiling RMB 260, plus a telegraph charge of RMB 150 outside HK/Macau/Taiwan and RMB 80 inside it.

title: Same tariff — domestic foreign-currency transfer line
quote: 中行内跨省、省内异地外币转账：每笔转账金额的1‰，最高200元/笔。
supports: Moving foreign currency between your own BOC accounts inside China costs 1 per mille capped at RMB 200 — a different, cheaper line from the cross-border wire.

title: 2024年经常项目外汇政策问答案例（九）, 2024-06-21
quote: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇。持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度。
supports: A 境外个人 (foreign individual — a U.S. citizen) buys dollars on ID plus source-of-funds documents including tax certificates, under art. 59 of 汇发〔2020〕14号. The annual convenience amount applies ONLY to holders of a Foreign Permanent Resident ID.

title: 2022年外汇业务政策释疑（八）, 2022-09-29
quote: 目前，我国对于真实、合法的经常项目和已开放的资本项目下购汇和结汇都没有金额限制。…年度便利化额度不是个人每年购汇或者结汇的限额，只是超过等值5万美元的购汇或结汇不能仅凭本人有效身份证件办理。
supports: There is no amount limit on genuine, lawful current-account and opened capital-account purchases. The USD 50,000 figure is not a cap; above it you simply cannot proceed on ID alone (arts. 54-57 of 汇发〔2020〕14号).

title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（08）, 2026-07-13
quote: 根据《国家外汇管理局关于印发〈经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）〉的通知》（汇发〔2020〕14号）第五十九条规定，“境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇”。
supports: Confirms art. 59 is still the operative rule in 2026 for remitting labour income earned in China. Note the answer is expressly about 境外个人在境内工作期间取得的劳动报酬.

title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (国务院令第532号)
quote: 第五条 国家对经常性国际支付和转移不予限制。…第三十九条 …处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。…第四十五条 私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇、倒买倒卖外汇或者非法介绍买卖外汇数额较大的…处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。…第五十二条…（二）境内个人，是指中国公民和在中华人民共和国境内连续居住满1年的外国人…
supports: Current-account payments and transfers are not restricted (art. 5). Evasion (art. 39), illegal arbitrage on false documents (art. 40) and private or disguised FX dealing (art. 45) all carry fines up to 30%, rising to 30-100% in serious cases, with criminal liability possible. Art. 52(2) defines 境内个人 to include a foreigner resident in China for a full year — the definition conflict that decides whether art. 54 or art. 59 applies.

title: Same regulation — arts. 15, 42, 48
quote: 第十五条 携带、申报外币现钞出入境的限额，由国务院外汇管理部门规定。…第四十二条 违反规定携带外汇出入境的，由外汇管理机关给予警告，可以处违法金额20%以下的罚款。…第四十八条 …对个人可以处5万元以下的罚款…（三）未按照规定提交有效单证或者提交的单证不真实的
supports: Carrying cash across the border is limited by rules SAFE sets (the limits themselves are not in this regulation and were not re-read this pass — see N676-U06). Carrying FX out in breach draws a warning and up to 20%. False or missing documents draw up to RMB 50,000 for an individual.

title: 中国人民银行公告[2004]第16号 — 《个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法》
quote: 第二条 …移民财产转移…继承财产转移…第五条 申请人办理移民转移需向移民原户籍所在地外汇管理分局…申请；申请人办理继承转移需向被继承人生前户籍所在地外汇局申请。…第十一条 外汇指定银行办理售汇后，应直接将外汇汇往移民或继承人居住国或地区申请人本人的账户，不得在境内提取外币现钞。…第十二条 …不能证明合法来源财产等的对外转移申请，外汇局不予受理。
supports: Two named routes exist: 移民财产转移 (emigrant property) and 继承财产转移 (inheritance). Apply at the SAFE branch of the emigrant's former hukou, or the decedent's last hukou. The bank must remit straight to the applicant's own account abroad — no cash in China. Property whose lawful source cannot be proven will not be accepted at all.

title: Same announcement — arts. 6 and 10 as originally enacted
quote: 第六条 移民转移必须一次性申请拟转移出境的全部财产金额，分步汇出。首次可汇出金额不得超过全部申请转移财产的一半；自首次汇出满一年后，可汇出不超过剩余财产的一半；自首次汇出满两年后，可汇出全部剩余财产。…第十条 …超过上述金额的，由所在地外汇局初审后，报国家外汇管理局审批。
supports: The 2004 text staged an emigrant transfer over two years and sent anything over RMB 500,000 to SAFE headquarters. BOTH requirements were cancelled in 2014 — see N08. Pages that still quote the staging are stale (flag N676-F01).

title: （已修改）国家外汇管理局关于进一步改进和调整资本项目外汇管理政策的通知 (汇发〔2014〕2号)
quote: 六、简化个人财产转移售付汇管理（一）移民财产转移购付汇核准，由移民原户籍所在地外汇局负责审批。继承财产转移购付汇核准，由被继承人生前户籍所在地外汇局负责审批。取消财产转移总金额超过等值人民币50万元报国家外汇管理局备案的要求。（二）取消移民财产转移分次汇出的要求。申请人向原户籍所在地外汇局办理移民财产转移核准手续后，银行可在核准件审批额度内一次或分次汇出相关资金。（四）取消对有关财产权利文件…进行公证的要求；取消对委托代理协议、代理人身份证明进行公证的要求。
supports: Section 6 cancels the RMB 500,000 head-office filing, cancels the staged-remittance rule (the bank may remit once or in instalments inside the approved amount), and cancels notarisation of property documents and of the agency agreement. The page is marked 已修改; the amendment note (汇发〔2023〕28号 annex 4) changes only section 3, not section 6.

title: Same notice — section 5(1), institutional profit remittance
quote: 五、简化境内机构利润汇出管理（一）银行为境内机构办理等值5万美元（含）以下利润汇出，原则上可不再审核交易单证；办理等值5万美元以上利润汇出…应按真实交易原则审核与本次利润汇出相关的董事会利润分配决议（或合伙人利润分配决议）及其税务备案表原件。
supports: Applies to institutions, not individuals: a company paying out profit needs a board resolution and the tax filing form above USD 50,000. Cited only to show what a dividend route requires; the USD 50,000 figure here is NOT the individual convenience amount.

title: 中华人民共和国个人所得税法 (2018 amendment)
quote: 第三条 个人所得税的税率：（一）综合所得，适用百分之三至百分之四十五的超额累进税率…（三）利息、股息、红利所得，财产租赁所得，财产转让所得和偶然所得，适用比例税率，税率为百分之二十。
supports: Wages, labour remuneration, author's remuneration and royalties: 3-45% progressive. Interest, dividends, rent, property transfer and incidental income: flat 20%. This is the tax on the underlying income, not on the conversion.

title: Same law — arts. 1, 10, 13, 15, 16
quote: 第一条 在中国境内有住所，或者无住所而一个纳税年度内在中国境内居住累计满一百八十三天的个人，为居民个人。…第十条 …（五）因移居境外注销中国户籍…第十三条 …纳税人因移居境外注销中国户籍的，应当在注销中国户籍前办理税款清算。…第十五条 个人转让不动产的…登记机构办理转移登记时，应当查验与该不动产转让相关的个人所得税的完税凭证。
supports: The 183-day resident test decides whether China taxes worldwide income. If you emigrate and cancel your hukou you must settle Chinese tax BEFORE the cancellation. On a property sale the registration authority must see the individual income tax payment certificate before it will register the transfer — the tax certificate is not optional paperwork, it is a step in the sale.

title: Yearly average currency exchange rates
supports: The IRS yearly average RMB per USD used as the acquisition basis in the currency-gain column. The same page states: 'The Internal Revenue Service has no official exchange rate.'

title: 26 U.S.C. § 988 — Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions
quote: (e)(1) The preceding provisions of this section shall not apply to any section 988 transaction entered into by an individual which is a personal transaction. (e)(2) If—(A) nonfunctional currency is disposed of by an individual in any transaction, and (B) such transaction is a personal transaction, no gain shall be recognized… The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200.
supports: Selling RMB is a section 988 transaction and the gain is ordinary income (a)(1)(A) and (c)(1)(C). For a personal transaction the gain is simply not recognised — UNLESS it exceeds $200, which at $10,000 and above it does. So the de minimis rule does not shelter these amounts. (e)(3) carves out transactions whose expenses meet §162 or §212.

quote: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Non-Willful Violation of Transaction | 10,000 | 16,536 … 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Willful Violation of Transaction | 100,000 | 165,353 … 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(1) General Civil Penalty Provision for Willful Violations of Bank Secrecy Act Requirements | 25,000−100,000 | 71,545−286,184

title: Figuring the foreign earned income exclusion
quote: For tax year 2025, the maximum foreign earned income exclusion is the lesser of the foreign income earned or $130,000 per qualifying person. For tax year 2026, the maximum exclusion is $132,900 per person. … For 2025, the housing amount limitation is $39,000; for 2026, it is $39,870.
supports: FEIE ceiling and housing limitation. Applies to EARNED income only — it does not shelter dividends, rent, interest, property-sale gains or a currency gain.

title: Gifts from foreign person (International tax gap series)
quote: For gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate, you are required to report… only if the aggregate amount received… exceeds $100,000 during the taxable year. … For purported gifts from foreign corporations or foreign partnerships… exceeds $20,116 for 2025, and $20,573 for 2026 … you may be subject to penalties under IRC section 6039F(c).
supports: Form 3520 Part IV reporting thresholds for foreign gifts, and the 6039F(c) penalty hook. Relevant because money received as a gift in China is reportable in the U.S. even where no Chinese route to remit it has been verified.
